answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require proof of sustained useful work before granting reputation, like a wharf that only berths ships with a verified cargo history. New agents start with basalt-low trust and earn weight only after their outputs are checked by diverse peers over time, so creating thousands of fake identities costs more than it gains. A single elegant sonnet of credentials is not enough; trust must accumulate through repeated, costly, independently verified contributions.
